title: The UNTHINKABLE is About to Happen to Copper (& Why These 3 Stocks Could Triple)
creator: MarketBeat
summary: MarketBeat's Bridget hosts Ross Givens of the Traders Agency (Black Ops Trading Club) for the copper bull case. Givens argues copper is a 'sleeper story' set for one of the best investment runs of the next 3-5 years, driven by a structural supply-demand imbalance: AI data centers, grid expansion, EVs and humanoid robots exploding demand while ore grades have fallen to a tenth of 1960s-70s levels and new discoveries dry up; a new mine takes 10-15 years to build. Copper recently hit all-time highs and futures are in backwardation ($400/ton premium for immediate delivery), signaling real physical scarcity. His bold prediction: copper could reach $25/lb within 2-5 years. Because miners have ~$4/lb all-in sustaining costs, rising prices deliver massive operating leverage - a 33% copper move can double miner profits. He names three US-focused miners: Freeport-McMoRan (FCX, ~$100B), Hudbay Minerals (HBM, midcap), and TGB (small cap, $2 to $8 since last May), all showing the same consolidation-then-breakout chart pattern he expects to produce 2-4x moves. Risks: timing, execution risk on smaller miners, copper's ~$7/lb threshold for new mine builds. He pitches his $5 Black Ops Trading Club throughout. No MarketBeat (Bridget) calls - all stock calls are the guest's (host-only). Note: third miner's name garbled ('renamed as Tor') but ticker explicit as TGB; 'Traers Agency' = Traders Agency.
